meaning: (Qal) to smite, strike, hammer, strike down

renderings.kjv: and with the hammer she smote

elsewhere.note: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
“They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I can find another.”
